This Annual Report covers the non-financial performance of Vallibel Finance PLC for the financial year ended 31 March 2026. Unless
otherwise stated, the sustainability information presented in this report, including economic, social, and governance disclosures, relates
solely to the operations of Vallibel Finance PLC and its branch network.
The Company’s consolidated financial statements include Vallibel Properties Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary. While the majority of non-
financial disclosures exclude the subsidiary, Green House Gas (GHG) emissions reporting has been prepared on a consolidated basis
and includes emissions arising from both Vallibel Finance PLC and Vallibel Properties Ltd. Any deviations from the general reporting
boundary are specifically disclosed within the relevant sections of this report.
There were no significant changes to the entities included within the sustainability reporting boundary during the reporting period.

52   RELATED PARTY DISCLOSURES
Vallibel Finance PLC (the Company) carried out transactions in the ordinary course of business on an arm's length basis at
commercial rates with parties who are defined as related parties as per the Sri Lanka Accounting Standard - LKAS 24 "Related Party
Disclosures".
52.1   Parent and Ultimate Controlling Party
In the opinion of Directors, the Company’s immediate and ultimate parent undertaking and controlling party is Vallibel Investments
(Private) Limited.
52.2   Key Management Personnel (KMP)
KMP are those persons having authority and responsibility for planning, directing and controlling the activities of the entity directly or
indirectly.
